content:
incident-bot: P1 Pager: multiple customer reports of inconsistent completions + elevated 5xx in prod us-east-1. Signal: route-flapping between variants + cache reuse of wrong model weights. Trigger: error_rate > 15% over 7m.

rishi (eng-runtime): taking this. grabbing proxy traces and cache index.

laura (eng-sre): oncall here. I'll stand up cache scans and watch for node OOMs.

rishi (eng-runtime): quick summary from traces: controlplane returns alias labels for model family 'delta-latest' that are not canonical ids; some requests resolve to delta-v9, others to delta-v7 depending on controlplane replica. Our cache keys are built with the human label and region prefix (kv:resp:model=delta:region=us-east-1:label=delta-latest:...) which means entries created when the alias pointed to v7 are later reused when alias resolves to v9 -> incompatible state. We also see churn where routing falls back to older variant under load, then back, causing serializable KV mismatch and some deserialization 500s.

anika (eng-platform): I can confirm a partial alias rollout happened during morning deploy (rollout 6312). One controlplane replica failed to pick up the canonical mapping due to a race in watch events; it served stale label->variant mappings for ~12 minutes.

ops-bot: sample proxy logs:
```
[2026-06-12T02:15:02Z] req=0xabc route=smart-complete alias=delta-latest -> routed=us-east-1a/delta-v7
cache_key=kv:resp:model=delta:region=us-east-1:label=delta-latest:variant_label=delta-v7:ctx=0x22
cache_hit=true ttl=64ms

[2026-06-12T02:15:03Z] req=0xabd route=smart-complete alias=delta-latest -> routed=us-east-1b/delta-v9
cache_key=kv:resp:model=delta:region=us-east-1:label=delta-latest:variant_label=delta-v9:ctx=0x23
cache_hit=false
```
This shows adjacent requests for same alias resolving to different variants and the cache using label-based keys that allowed reuse of v7 artifacts when v9 was expected.

jules (eng-ml): delta-v7 vs v9 have different tokenizers and postprocessing hooks (v9 enforces structured fields). That mismatch explains missing fields and user-visible truncation.

rishi (eng-runtime): mitigation options: A) disable alias fallback behavior in the controlplane so routing won't bounce, B) targeted eviction of keys that include label=delta-latest in us-east-1 shards, C) temporarily pin enterprise accounts to a canonical variant while we reconcile alias state, D) restart controlplane replicas to flush stale watcher state. I'll execute in that sequence.

laura (eng-sre): I'll run the dry-run scan across cache-us-east-0{1..3} to get key counts and samples.

ops-bot: dry-run scan results: ~4.2k keys matching "kv:resp:model=delta:region=us-east-1:label=delta-latest:*" across shards. Sample keys show variant_label values v6, v7, v9.

deploy-bot: API: PATCH /api/controls/alias_fallback -> off. Change applied to controlplane; propagation started. Audit id 5987.

anika (eng-platform): I'm initiating a rolling restart of the controlplane replicas in us-east-1 to clear watcher caches and force canonical alias resolution. Doing 1 node at a time. ETA ~8m.

laura (eng-sre): eviction command plan (rotate across cache-us-east-0{1..3}):
```bash
# dry-run
redis-cli -h cache-us-east-01 --scan --pattern 'kv:resp:model=delta:region=us-east-1:label=delta-latest:*' | head -n 500 > /tmp/delta-keys-sample.txt
# after review delete in batches
cat /tmp/delta-keys.txt | xargs -r -n 200 redis-cli -h cache-us-east-01 del
```
I'll execute during a low-traffic interval and keep batch sizes conservative to avoid cache stampede.

tom (support): support queue: 14 tickets; 5 enterprise-level (E-201, E-202, E-310, E-415, E-799). Notifying affected accounts with status update and ETA.

rishi (eng-runtime): applying per-account pin for E-201 & E-310 to delta-v9 for 2h to prevent further inconsistent outputs. Commands applied.

laura (eng-sre): running eviction on cache-us-east-01 now. Deleted ~1.6k keys. Proceeding to cache-us-east-02.

jules (eng-ml): running smoke evals on delta-v9 using enterprise prompt set; outputs look aligned with expected structured schema. No regression so far.

anika (eng-platform): controlplane rolling restart completed; alias resolution now returning canonical ids consistently. Verified via resolver debug endpoint: alias=delta-latest -> canonical=delta-v9 across all replicas.

rishi (eng-runtime): after eviction and controlplane restart, route churn subsided and cache hits now map to correct canonical ids. Error rate down from 15.3% -> 2.8% over 10m.

deploy-bot: queued hotfix: change cache key generator to include canonical_variant_id and rollout_epoch, and add safety TTL shrink during rollouts. PR# 6360. Target: hotfix within 48h.

laura (eng-sre): completed eviction across all shards. total keys removed ~4.2k. Watching for population spikes; implementing small randomized jitter on TTLs to avoid stampede.

tom (support): customers acknowledged update. Two enterprise customers requested immediate post-incident call and SLA credits; routing to accounts.

jules (eng-ml): adding enterprise prompts to continuous eval and flagging any regression alerts.

rishi (eng-runtime): handoff notes:
- status: mitigated; alias fallback disabled, targeted eviction done, controlplane restarted, enterprise pins applied.
- impact: ~14 customers affected; peak 5xx + wrong-variant outputs for ~25 minutes. Enterprise mitigation in place for 2 accounts; outreach ongoing for others.
- root cause: alias "label shadowing" during partial rollout led to non-canonical alias mappings across controlplane replicas combined with cache keys that used human labels and region prefix. This allowed incompatible KV reuse and route oscillation.
- immediate fixes: turned off alias fallback, evicted affected prefixes, restarted controlplane replicas to force canonical resolution, pinned enterprise accounts, queued cache-key hotfix.
- follow-ups (owners):
  - eng-platform (anika): ensure alias resolver returns canonical_variant_id and add rollout consistency checks + increased watch-event reliability (owner: anika).
  - eng-runtime (rishi): update cache key schema to include canonical_variant_id + rollout_epoch; implement safety TTL/Jitter during rollouts (owner: rishi).
  - eng-ml (jules): expand evals with enterprise prompt sets and add structured-output regression alerts (owner: jules).
  - eng-sre (laura): add alerting for alias<>canonical divergence and high cross-variant cache-hit ratio; document eviction playbook (owner: laura).
  - support (tom): draft customer-facing postmortem and coordinate SLA/credits with accounts (owner: tom).

anika (eng-platform): opening PR now for alias-resolver hardening and adding integration test that compares label->canonical consistency across replicas. Targeting hotfix in 36h.

laura (eng-sre): I'll keep tightened thresholds for 2 hours and hand off to next oncall. Adding commands + logs to incident runbook.

rishi (eng-runtime): drafting postmortem skeleton and timeline; will include the tracer samples, eviction commands, and resolver logs. Handoff in 40m. Thanks all for the quick coordination. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident P1 marked mitigated at 2039876710. Duration: 00:02:47. Paging closed.
